title: Spinner stops looping under reduced motion
intent: With the browser's reduced-motion preference set, every Spinner on the Spinner page keeps its box but runs no animation, because the shipped CSS sets animation-name to none under the media query.
preconditions: The browser context reports prefers-reduced-motion: reduce before the page loads.
The mark is decorative and aria-hidden; each demo's busy container carries aria-busy.

steps.expect: The page reports the reduced-motion preference and both demos render a Spinner mark with a nonzero box.

steps.action: Read each mark's computed animation and running animations, and its transform across two frames.
steps.expect: The loop is still declared infinite, its animation-name is none, no animation runs and the transform does not change.
